# DogsBay DITA tutorial — Practice

## Practice

- [Practice exercises](https://dogsbay.ai/dita-tutorial/practice/exercises.md): Apply topic design, maps, reuse, conditions, output review, and house rules without copying a complete solution.
- [Suggested exercise solutions](https://dogsbay.ai/dita-tutorial/practice/solutions.md): Compare your decisions and observed output with the expected results for the five DITA practice exercises.
